maria: quick follow-up from the compact-envelopes canary: saw reassembly miss spike, proposing an auto-opaque fallback circuit.
Ajay: agree, need numeric guard and finance check.
Kai: suggested guard: if reassembly_miss_rate > 0.7% AND ingest_p50 > 200ms for 3 consecutive 1m windows, flip shard to opaque-fallback. revert after 10m stable.
Sophia: add dashboard tiles: reassembly_miss_rate (1m/5m), ingest_p50/p95, opaque_mode, ambiguous_attrib_count. alert if ambiguous_revenue_estimate > $50/day for canary customers.
Ajay: add nightly recon job to compare dual-write token_proxy diffs; auto-rollback if billing_delta_ratio > 0.2% in 1h.
Kai: implement lightweight tombstone eviction and bloom early-warning; tune LRU to keep eviction_rate <100/s per shard.
maria: action items: Kai (auto-toggle + LRU tuning), Ajay (SnQL monitor + recon job), Sophia (dash + playbook). will PR changes tonight.
infra-bot: canary toggle scheduled at 2026-03-24T02:00Z.
Notes: keep thresholds numeric; conservative auto-fallback to protect billing.
